stage1.uncertain_rule: smallest band with validation accuracy >= 0.95 outside it
stage1.preprocessing: load_rgb (EXIF) -> cv2.resize(image_size, INTER_AREA) -> uint8 [0,255]; raw RGB [0,255]; rescaling/normalisation is built into the Keras EfficientNet backbone

localizer.architecture: anchor-free grid detector, MobileNetV2 C4+C5 backbone
localizer.preprocessing: load_rgb -> cv2.resize(cache_side, INTER_AREA) -> cv2.resize(input_size, INTER_AREA) -> mobilenet_v2 preprocess_input
localizer.output: ch0 objectness logit | ch1-4 softplus(l,t,r,b) in grid-cell units

gvb.mapping_source: project owner's confirmed mapping (no mapping file in the ZIP) — NOT provable from the data alone
gvb.preprocessing: load_rgb (EXIF) -> square context crop centred on the box (side = longer box side*(1+2*pad), black border outside the image) -> resize to image_size -> uint8 [0,255]; raw RGB [0,255] -> fixed 1x1 conv inside the model: RGB->BGR + ImageNet mean subtraction (ResNet50 convention); TTA 'none'

indicators: possible label noise / ambiguous images (many confident errors)
small / poor crops err more often

icdas.mapping_source: icdascl.zip class folder names (folder name = ICDAS score)
icdas.preprocessing: load_rgb (EXIF) -> square letterbox 224x224 (aspect kept, black padding) -> uint8 [0,255]; raw RGB [0,255]; rescaling/normalisation is built into the Keras EfficientNet backbone; TTA 'hflip+zoom'

indicators: possible label noise / ambiguous images (many confident errors)

run.status: research proof of concept — not clinically validated
run.architecture: multi-CNN cascade: CNN1 (stage 1) -> Stage 2 FDI tooth detector -> localizer -> lesion->tooth association -> CNN2 (G.V. Black) + CNN3 (ICDAS) per lesion

leakage_control.split: one stratified GROUP split shared by all models

fdi.model: Stage 2 FDI tooth detector (tooth boxes + FDI two-digit number)
fdi.architecture: anchor-free grid detector, MobileNetV2 C4+C5 backbone (cavity-localizer design) + FDI softmax class head
fdi.preprocessing: load_rgb -> cv2.resize(cache_side, INTER_AREA) -> cv2.resize(input_size, INTER_AREA) -> mobilenet_v2 preprocess_input (= loc_prepare)
fdi.output: ch0 objectness logit | ch1-4 softplus(l,t,r,b) in grid-cell units | ch5.. FDI class logits (order = class_names)

dataset_report.suitability: object detection (bounding boxes with FDI codes)
